claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: Meprylcaine is a local anesthetic that inhibits monoamine transporters and blocks sodium channels, but at 2.5 uM in a 5-day pooled viability screen it is expected to produce little or no selective cytotoxicity, since its pharmacological actions are reversible channel/transporter blockade rather than lethal cell damage.
